newsitem.title: USA: Genesis says talks continue on unit sale.
newsitem.headline: Genesis says talks continue on unit sale.

text.p: Genesis International Financial Services Inc Friday said its board approved further talks with an unidentified group of investors and financial institutions interested in buying one of its major operating subsidiaries.
Genesis said it expects to receive a term sheet today with details in support of the group's initial letter of intent.

The company's chief executive officer, Mohamed Khairy Mohamed Zayed, II, said, "The preliminary offer on the table to purchase this particular subsidiary would have a materially substantial positive effect on the company as a whole. It could allow us to increase the rate of our expansion and growth, and insure accretive earnings and shareholder value well into the future."
The company expects to release details on the offer upon receipt of the term sheet later today.
